user.title: Environment Canada Weather Alerts
user.description:
Set up your Environment Canada weather alerts region.

**How to find your zone code:**
1. Go to [weather.gc.ca](https://weather.gc.ca/index_e.html?layers=alert)
2. Open the alert map or search for your city, then open your region page
3. Look at the URL. It will look like:
   `https://weather.gc.ca/warnings/report_e.html?nl18=`
4. Your zone code is the part before the `=` sign (for example `nl18`)

You can paste the full warning URL or just the zone code.

data_description.zone_code: The EC zone code (for example `nl18`) or the full URL from weather.gc.ca/warnings/report_e.html
data_description.friendly_name: Optional. If left blank, the official Environment Canada region name is used.
